cards.example_en: Students are under a lot of pressure before exams.
cards.example_zh: 考试前学生承受着很大的压力。

cards.example_en: She wants to pursue a career in law.

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：保持；剩余
cards.example_en: Passengers remain in their seats until the bus stops.
cards.example_zh: 乘客要留在座位上，直到公交车停下。

cards.example_en: We shared dumplings at a restaurant near the station.
cards.example_zh: 我们在车站附近的一家菜馆分着吃了饺子。

cards.example_en: Hot rice and fried eggs were ready when I got home.
cards.example_zh: 我到家时，热白米和煎蛋已经准备好了。

cards.example_en: Too much salt ruined the soup we had at dinner.
cards.example_zh: 盐放得太多，我们晚饭的汤全毁了。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：三明治
cards.example_en: I ate a chicken sandwich on the crowded school bus.
cards.example_zh: 我在拥挤的校车上吃了一个鸡肉三明治。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：感觉；意义
cards.example_en: The last sentence makes no sense without the chart.
cards.example_zh: 没有那张图表，最后一句就讲不通。

cards.example_en: Someone should shut the window if the rain starts.
cards.example_zh: 如果下起雨来，应该有人把窗户关上。

cards.example_en: Cutting vegetables is a useful skill at home.
cards.example_zh: 在家切菜是一项很有用的技能。

cards.example_en: Together we can solve this maths problem before lunch.
cards.example_zh: 午饭前我们可以一起解决这道数学题。

cards.example_en: Stir the porridge with a wooden spoon, not a fork.
cards.example_zh: 搅拌粥要用木匙，不要用叉子。

cards.example_en: I stopped putting sugar in my morning cocoa.
cards.example_zh: 我早上喝可可时不再放糖了。

cards.example_en: The sweet mangoes from the market were gone by evening.
cards.example_zh: 从市场买来的甜芒果到傍晚就吃完了。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：处理；应对
cards.example_en: The council must tackle the litter problem near the shops.
cards.example_zh: 市政部门必须处理商店附近的垃圾问题。
